    Reversal invariance of finite-string detectors #

    The finite detector index identifies a string with its formal reverse. This file constructs the corresponding natural linear equivalence of detector spaces. The proof uses the already formalized change-of-split theorem: at the source end of a nontrivial word, the complete-word detector is the swapped pair presentation of the detector of the reversed word.
